case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Monika Zellner,

Thank you for your quote and for specifying the available allocation and delivery window. We recognise that constrained capacity makes firm commitments more useful than forecasts.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09). Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3).

Our proposal rests on exchanging a binding annual quantity under a longer agreement for reserved capacity and confirmed delivery dates, giving you a dependable planning basis. We are flexible on lead time; the longer-lead-time option comes closest to your quoted delivery window, so which option works best for your planning?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 27.01 per unit, lead time 42 days, 23,400 units per year, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 26.27 per unit, lead time 56 days, 23,400 units per year, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 27.01 per unit, lead time 35 days, 23,400 units per year, 24-month agreement.

Could you send a delivery schedule with the monthly quantities you can commit to?

We look forward to agreeing a dependable supply arrangement with you.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.

We note your revised volume forecast and have selected the 56-day lead time option, as it aligns with our current capacity utilization.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Based on this 24-month agreement for 23,400 units annually, we propose a unit price of €31.90. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. A detailed delivery schedule will be provided upon conclusion of this commercial agreement.

This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
